tools.name: search_bots
tools.description: Search public ShareGrokBots listings by text and optional category. Returns name, credit, live bot link, and the community signal: `votes` from signed-in members and `adds` from people who opened the bot through its listing. tools.name: submit_bot
tools.description: Submit a public Grok bot page to the directory. Requires the creator X handle and the source X post URL. ShareGrokBots does not test, score, or review the bots it lists. Prompt text is never stored or returned.

tools.name: my_listings
tools.description: List the member's submissions with status, votes, and adds. ShareGrokBots does not test, score, or review the bots it lists. Prompt text is never returned.

tools.name: get_bot
tools.description: Fetch one public listing by slug. Credits the creator X post and carries the listing's `votes` and `adds`. ShareGrokBots does not test, score, or review the bots it lists. Never returns prompt text.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the categories used to file listings, grouped as market or trades. Old slugs appear under aliases.

tools.name: latest
tools.description: Newest public listings, newest first. Each carries its `votes` and `adds`. ShareGrokBots does not test, score, or review the bots it lists.

tools.name: most_voted
tools.description: Listings the community voted up, most votes first. Votes come from signed-in members, one per person per bot.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_bots, my_listings, get_bot · Private data: list_categories · Public sink: submit_bot, get_bot.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_bots, my_listings, get_bot · Private data: list_categories · Public sink: submit_bot, get_bot

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
